purpose: Fourth-pass official-source verification for five still-open Batch-51 identity or current-status conflicts. The same V53 browser-acceptance task remains unclaimed. No second runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only first-party operator pages, NHS or local-authority pages, Charity Commission records and Companies House records are promoted. Current activity, a registered office or an exact-address service does not alone prove lease continuation or legal completion.
method.historical_status_policy: Auction Sold, Sold Prior, Withdrawn or Archive labels remain historical statements.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.resolved_fact: CHARIS Refugees, charity number 1169400, currently operates its headquarters and Taunton Welcome Hub at 16-17 Hammet Street. Its first-party page, Somerset Council and the Charity Commission agree on the exact address. This verifies present occupation, but CHARIS Refugees is legally distinct from CHARIS GRANTS LIMITED company 04762902, whose registered office is in Peterborough; the auction-named tenant and current occupier therefore require lease-party reconciliation.

rows.address: Millennium Medical Centre, 121 Weoley Castle Road, Birmingham, B29 5QD
rows.resolved_fact: Birmingham and Solihull ICB currently lists Millennium Medical Centre among South-area GP practices, and the NHS DSP Toolkit records a standards-met publication dated 25 June 2026 at 121 Weoley Castle Road. The NHS service profile simultaneously states that the GP surgery is currently closed. Organisational and commissioning activity is therefore verified, but open-to-patients status remains contradictory.

rows.address: Lloyds Chambers, The Square, Barnstaple, Devon, EX32 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: Companies House continues to record the controlling person of D SCOFF'S LTD at 1 The Square, Barnstaple, EX32 8LS. This strengthens the replacement-operator candidate after SCOFFS ORIGINAL LIMITED was dissolved, but the public record does not prove that D SCOFF'S occupies the restaurant demise within Lloyds Chambers or received the former lease.

rows.address: 144-148 Regent House, York Road, Hartlepool, TS26 9DU
rows.resolved_fact: KLSD COMMUNITY VENTURES C.I.C. remains active at Regent House 144-146 York Road, has cafe and educational SIC activities, and has accounts made up to 31 May 2025. This confirms a current exact-address operating-company route after the stated cafe term ended on 23 June 2026, but it does not establish renewal, holding over or a replacement lease.

rows.address: 14-18 High Street, Heathfield, East Sussex, TN21 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: Companies House records THE FACTORY SHOP LIMITED as In Administration and its insolvency page records administration beginning 28 January 2026 after a CVA. The first-party store route still does not expose a readable exact Heathfield entry, so present operation at 14-18 High Street cannot be promoted from non-official directories.
